about: Made-up sample cards from the made-up Turnip Hollow Community Garden Club. Every name, plot and event here is fictional.

cards.blurb: Spring work day set for the first Saturday after the last frost; Otis runs the sign-up sheet
cards.text: Spring planning meeting, held in the tool shed. Eleven members came. We agreed the spring work day is the first Saturday after the last frost date, starting at 9 and finishing by noon. Otis will run the sign-up sheet and pin it to the shed door.

cards.blurb: Raised beds 3 and 7 need new boards before planting; club pays from the repair fund
cards.text: Raised beds 3 and 7 have rotten corner boards. Ferris measured them: four boards each, untreated cedar. The club will pay from the repair fund, which has enough for this but not much else until the plant sale.

cards.blurb: Plant sale moved to the second Sunday in May so it doesn't clash with the school fair
cards.text: The plant sale moves to the second Sunday in May. Last year it clashed with the school fair and we sold half as many seedlings. Juniper will ask the library if we can put a poster in the window.

cards.blurb: New rule: hoses go back on the reel after every use, after two were run over by the mower
cards.text: Two hoses were run over by the mower last autumn. New rule from today: hoses go back on the reel after every use, no exceptions. Bea will paint a reminder on the reel.

cards.blurb: Compost bins 1 and 2 are full; bin 3 is the one to add to until the turn
cards.text:
Bea: Bins 1 and 2 are full to the top. Please only add to bin 3 until we turn them.
Hollis: Noted. I'll put a sign on bin 3 so people stop piling onto 2.

cards.blurb: Turning day for the compost is the Sunday after the work day; bring forks and gloves
cards.text:
Hollis: Turning day is the Sunday after the work day, 10 o'clock. Bring a fork and gloves.
Bea: I'll bring the thermometer so we can check the middle of bin 1 is hot enough.

cards.blurb: No citrus peel, onions or cooked food in the bins: it brought the rats last year
cards.text: Marigold: Reminder for everyone: no citrus peel, onions or cooked food in the compost. Cooked food is what brought the rats last year. Coffee grounds and eggshells are fine.

cards.blurb: Bin lids are warped; Ferris will build new ones from the leftover bed boards
cards.text: Ferris: The bin lids are warped and rain gets in. If the cedar order for beds 3 and 7 has offcuts, I'll make new lids from those instead of buying more wood.

cards.blurb: Summer watering rota is two people a week, Monday to Sunday, swapped on the group chat
cards.text: Call about the summer watering rota. We settled on two people per week, Monday to Sunday. If you can't do your week, swap it on the group chat and tell Juniper so the sheet stays right.

cards.blurb: Water early morning or after 6pm only; midday watering wastes the tank
cards.text: Water before 9 in the morning or after 6 in the evening. Watering at midday mostly evaporates and the rain tank runs dry by July if we do it.

cards.blurb: Rain tank tap leaks; Otis ordered a new washer and will fit it on the work day
cards.text: The tap on the rain tank drips all night. Otis ordered a new washer and will fit it on the work day. Until then, close the tap fully and put the bucket under it.

cards.blurb: Seed swap is in the shed on the first Saturday of March, 10 to 1, free to everyone
cards.text: Draft flyer: Turnip Hollow Seed Swap. First Saturday of March, 10 to 1, in the garden shed. Free to everyone, members or not. Bring seeds in labelled envelopes, take what you'll grow.

cards.blurb: Label every envelope with plant, variety and the year the seed was saved
cards.text: Please label every envelope with the plant, the variety and the year the seed was saved. Seeds older than three years go on the 'try your luck' table.

cards.blurb: Tomato seedlings for the swap come from Marigold's greenhouse: three varieties
cards.text: Marigold is growing tomato seedlings for the swap: a cherry, a beefsteak and a yellow pear. Thirty of each, one per person until noon, then take what's left.

cards.blurb: Six volunteers signed up for the seed swap; still need someone on the welcome table
cards.text: Sign-ups so far: Otis (setup), Bea and Hollis (sorting table), Juniper (posters), Marigold (seedlings), Ferris (packing up). Still need one person on the welcome table from 10 to 11.

cards.blurb: Welcome table covered: Hollis takes 10 to 11, then moves to sorting
cards.text: Update: Hollis will do the welcome table from 10 to 11, then move to the sorting table. That covers every slot.

cards.blurb: Plots 1 to 12 run north to south; the shed and the rain tank are at the north end
cards.text: The plots are numbered 1 to 12 from north to south. The shed and the rain tank sit at the north end by the gate. Plots 11 and 12 get afternoon shade from the hedge.

cards.blurb: Plot 9 is free; first person on the waiting list gets it at the spring work day
cards.text: Plot 9 is free this year. The first person on the waiting list gets it, and Juniper will show them round on the spring work day.

cards.blurb: Raised beds 3 and 7 belong to the shared herb garden, not to a member
cards.text: Raised beds 3 and 7 are the shared herb garden. Anyone can pick from them. Please cut herbs with scissors rather than pulling, so they grow back.

cards.blurb: Aphids on the broad beans in plots 4 and 5; try a hard spray of water before anything else
cards.text:
Otis: Black aphids all over the broad beans in plots 4 and 5.
Marigold: Knock them off with a hard spray of water first, and pinch out the bean tips. It usually does the job.

cards.blurb: Ladybirds are back by the beans; no spray needed this year
cards.text: Otis: Update on the beans: the ladybirds have turned up and the aphids are mostly gone. No spray needed.
